description: React component for a unified login and registration page supporting email/password sign-in and sign-up, role assignment, and redirection based on user metadata.

classes.name: LoginRegister
classes.description: React functional component providing authentication UI with sign-in and sign-up functionalities, role management, and user redirection.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Handles user sign-in process, including validation, calling Supabase auth, and redirecting based on role.

methods.name: handleSignUp
methods.description: Handles user registration, including role assignment, calling Supabase sign-up, and prompting email confirmation.

methods.name: TabButton
methods.description: Component for switching between sign-in and sign-up tabs.
